notes:
- Profile and Library load again: AniList broke four fields in the profile query; asking for any of them failed the whole request with a server error, which is why those pages showed the nap screen while Home worked. The charts read the working statistics block now.
- Your list is there before the network is: a cold start paints the copy already on your device first, refreshes behind it, and keeps it - marked Saved copy - when AniList does not answer.
- A library icon that looks like a library, instead of the Stats tab's stopwatch.
- No more empty stat charts: formats, genres, tags and release years come from the populated statistics block.
- Library and profile UX: pull to refresh on the library grid, a refresh control on the profile, a title count in the library bar and a crossfading profile title.
- Twenty-three more ways for Ani-chan to be asleep, four more rate-limit lines and twelve more ambient jokes.
